methods.name: CompletedWrapUpLogsSevenTurnsWithBoundedUsageAndNoDialogueText
methods.rationale: Only retained provider proof for purpose wrap_up plus six prior turns => log turn_count 7, not 8; completed token usage and dialogue/key redaction.

methods.name: ReassignmentBeforeDispatchCannotChargeTheReplacementRoute
methods.rationale: Actual dispatch/assignment gate preserves stale epoch native ordering, no HTTP/meter charge, then fresh replacement model/key success. Different from missing expected epoch.

methods.name: MissingExpectedEpochCannotStartAPaidConversationCall
methods.rationale: Null expected epoch separately exercises fail-closed omission before any paid attempt. No equivalent stale-epoch assertion covers this input.

methods.name: NormalProviderUsesEachSpeakersExplicitPersonalRouteAndMetersConversationRole
methods.rationale: Distinct two-speaker model/key routing, unknown speaker unavailable, actual prompt context/private-history exclusion, Unicode text bounds, max tokens, completed conversation-role usage and redacted logging.

methods.name: MarriageActivityReachesOnlyTheSpeakersPersonalConversationContext
methods.rationale: Personal observer marriage activity reaches prompt; force_marriage and activity with surname choice request validation are rejected. Not equivalent to response surname membership.

methods.name: UnknownStructuredEffectIsRejectedAndOnlyBoundedFailureIsLogged
methods.rationale: Valid HTTP envelope with unknown settlement_transfer structured effect reaches effect parser, not malformed envelope parser. Failed 7/3-token charging and bounded log distinct.

methods.name: PersonalSurnameModelsReceiveOnlyOriginalChoicesAndMeterRejectedOutput
methods.rationale: Surname-specific JSON schema and original choices, own model/key for both speakers, invented surname and extra grant_resources field failed usage, only None effect; distinct from ordinary conversation context.

methods.name: DeferredModelAnswerTerminatesOneMeteredDecision
methods.rationale: Unknown candidate, out-of-range confidence and valid safe_idle are separate admission outcomes. Real registered model-work wrapper, native tick/admission fallback, one request/attempt and queue retirement retained.

methods.name: ListsAndModelTestsExplainTheSameFailureWithoutLeakingOrRetrying
methods.rationale: Status/code/type precedence and specific billing/auth/rate guidance are distinct externally visible inputs, including 408 vs 504, type-only quota fallback, and misleading 500 invalid-key code. Native listing/setup calls, free-list/charged-setup accounting, secrecy, retry/cache assertions all retained.

methods.name: UnreadableErrorsStillExplainTheHttpStatus
methods.rationale: Invalid JSON, root array, invalid code/type shapes and scalar error are independently different malformed inputs into HTTP failure reader. Native list/setup routes and all accounting/redaction/cache checks retained.

methods.name: OversizedErrorStillExplainsTheHttpStatus
methods.rationale: Body-limit exception path distinct from malformed JSON/type paths. Keep exact 300000-byte response through both native routes.
